Class OpponentPanel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.OpponentPanel
public class OpponentPanel extends Object
Renders the opponents: the box ring anchored to the window's right edge and the collapsible per-opponent stats menu. Owns the PlayerBoxNode instances and keeps them in sync with each snapshot.
